data.title: Bitmine Surges 8% on Ethereum Strength After Cantor Fitzgerald Doubles Its Target, SharpLink Advances 9%, Strategy Gains 4%
data.description: Cantor Fitzgerald just doubled its price target on a crypto treasury stock sitting on millions of Ethereum tokens, and the timing of Friday's rally raises a question every holder needs to answer before the U.S. close.
data.keywords: Cantor Fitzgerald, treasury names, SBET, price target, Ethereum, Bitmine Immersion Technologies
